name: AutomationDirect SD1-040-RR disconnecting switch
summary: SD1-040-RR disconnecting switch arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: SD1-040-RR is the drawing identifier for disconnecting switch in AutomationDirect's Non-Fused Disconnects collection. A disconnecting switch provides the switching or isolation function stated for the selected product. The switch body, handle and connecting operating parts may need separate drawings.

For example, in a machine control panel with a door-operated main switch, use the SD1-040-RR reference to coordinate power-terminal approach, operating shaft and door handle. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Power Products/Non-fused Disconnects/SD1-040-RR.DWG for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep power-terminal approach, operating shaft and door handle visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named SD1-040-RR drawing and its disconnecting switch role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
